status_statement: The exact Epoch bounded counterexample task and the general monomial-coefficient nonnegativity conjecture remain open, but the all-partition-lengths-at-most-4 range is now known positive.
baseline_facts: The convention is P(t)=c^(t*lambda)_(t*mu,t*nu), with lambda outer; all three partitions are nonempty, length at most 7 and size at most 30.
The frozen degree bound is deg P <= binomial(length(lambda)+1,2) <= 28, so exact values at t=1,...,29 determine the complete rational monomial-basis polynomial.
The local t+1, constant-one and constant-zero cases are checker regressions, not negative-coefficient candidates.

known_route_baselines.scope: all three partitions have length at most 4
known_route_baselines.result: Every monomial coefficient of the stretched Littlewood--Richardson polynomial is nonnegative.
known_route_baselines.research_consequence: A novel counterexample search must have maximum partition length at least 5; an exclusion wholly inside length 4 merely reproduces a known theorem.

known_route_baselines.result: All coefficients except possibly the linear coefficient are proved positive.
known_route_baselines.research_consequence: The linear coefficient and lower-dimensional five-part cases are sharper unresolved places to inspect than an undirected all-coefficient sweep.

verification_caveats: Negativity must be in the ordinary monomial t basis, not a Newton, binomial, h-star or sample-value basis.
Both independent exact implementations must reproduce all 29 values and the complete reduced rational polynomial; any resource ceiling is inconclusive.
provenance_caveats: The 2026 preprint is a public primary-source novelty baseline, not a peer-reviewed final authority.
The length and size caps belong to the Epoch task; a witness outside them could affect the global conjecture but would not solve this frozen target.
